notes.title: 《ELISSA ：Body in the bedroom》DEMO Open!
notes.content:
ELISSA: Hanging Dead in the Bedroom is a black and white hand-drawn mystery game. 

① The protagonist MEL Gideon accidentally encounters a hanging incident, and after careful observation, he finds contradictions and doubts that contradict his conclusion. 

② Next, you'll investigate the setting, solve puzzles, and talk to the characters to get key information and move the plot forward. When all the investigations are over, the truth of what happened... 

③ game suggestions can give us a message, we will carefully review and reply! Look forward to your positive feedback! Look forward to enjoying it!

notes.title: There is no complicated and bizarre death scene, "my" reality, death is so simpl
notes.content:
Perhaps, burning the letter and the cigarette together is the best choice for me.

——[b]Mel Gideon[/b]



“I never want to see that sharp, bitter face of Wiswan again.

Did I raise any objections at that time? Or question him? Challenge him?

No, I remained silent.

Even though anger surged within me like a tide, seeping into every crevice of my being, there was a voice in the center of this heated whirlpool that kept reminding me:

Maybe he was right.

Once, I immersed myself day and night, lost in building my own fantasies, abandoning all the joys of life.

Can that rusty old full-length mirror by the door still reflect my outline through the thick dust?

Just pacing in this small room brings a sense of satisfaction.

Even desire has become pure.

Yet yesterday, the world forever lost its sun.

The sound of heavy paper striking the metal surface was as light as a feather.

Even though I don’t want to face this letter, it was sent by a reader, so I must look.

Look… and see who has so much kindness, willing to waste ink to pity me, this forgotten little writer.”

[img][/img]Hello, everyone! This is indie[b]《ELISSA ：Body in the bedroom》[/b]

It's an interactive fiction game , exploring the setting, solving puzzles, and adding some horror elements.

The game features a unique black-and-white art style, with independently composed music for different segments, creating an immersive and eerie atmosphere for our game world.

We will be updating the game content from time to time. If you like our game or are interested, please add it to your wishlist! Thank you for your support!
